summary: Gores Holdings XI, Inc., a blank-check company, filed an 8-K announcing that its units will begin separate trading of the Class A ordinary shares and warrants on August 13, 2026. The announcement is a routine administrative event following its IPO, with no change in the company's business or capital structure. Holders must contact the transfer agent, Equiniti Trust Company, to separate units; no fractional warrants will be issued. This is a procedural SPAC update without special-situation implications, so it is classified as None.
